answer: Identity activation costs an iterated hash that checkpoints every hundred thousand steps, so the work is provable step by step and a skipped checkpoint invalidates the whole chain. Forging six hundred identities means six hundred full hash runs with no shared work between them, and the checkpoint log exposes any farm that tries to reuse one run twice. The lantern of the design is public, the ember of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the dune of honest work is what finally pays.
